LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lorica.label: lorica segmentata
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Lorica.description: Overlapping iron bands laced over a leather harness. It turns blades well, though the wearer walks a little slower.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Galea.label: galea
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Galea.description: A bronze-trimmed legionary helmet with wide cheek guards and a red horsehair crest.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Tunica.label: tunica
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Tunica.description: A knee-length wool tunic with a narrow border, belted at the waist. Every citizen owns two.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Toga.label: toga
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Toga.description: A great half-circle of white wool wrapped around the body and over the left shoulder. Only citizens may wear it; a purple border marks a magistrate.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Laurel.label: laurel wreath
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Laurel.description: A wreath of laurel leaves beaten from gold, the crown of a general in triumph. A slave once stood behind him whispering that he was only a man.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_FieldCoat.label: legion field coat
LanguageData.HE_Roma_FieldCoat.description: A long double-breasted coat in imperial crimson with bronze buttons and an eagle gorget at the throat.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_SteelHelmet.label: legion steel helmet
LanguageData.HE_Roma_SteelHelmet.description: A steel helmet with a narrow brim and a tall bronze comb, painted crimson, with a bronze eagle on the front.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_FieldUniform.label: legion field uniform
LanguageData.HE_Roma_FieldUniform.description: A grey-green field tunic with crimson collar patches, bronze buttons, a cross strap and two breast pockets.
